plan.title: Reject eRFX RFQ bid during evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared eRFX RFQ Responses screen as the buyer.

args.goal: On the buyer Responses screen, reject the submitted vendor bid with a reason and stop when the rejection is confirmed on screen

steps.note: Perform and observe the bid rejection action, which has no dedicated catalog step.
